_: The character sheet's layout. Re-read every time the sheet opens (Tab), so edits show on the next open, game running. Fonts are point sizes; cells and gaps are pixels; column weights are relative. Any caption or stat row that ends in one of rule_chars pads itself with that character to the full width of its column; divider is the vertical rule between columns.

panel._: inset from the screen edges, px; the container screen uses the same
panel._min: the frame never shrinks below this (logical px); below it the frame keeps its size and runs off screen instead of squeezing the content

columns._: right 0 = the right column hugs its grid; the others share the rest

gear.caption: --[ EQUIPMENT ]-
gear._slots: row/col on the gear grid; label = none | left | right | above | below (the caption takes the neighbouring cell); kinds = ItemCatalog kinds that equip here; spacers hold a column open

stats._art: optional lines drawn above the caption in the art font, dim; corporation-agnostic; keep lines under about 30 characters
stats.caption: ==[ ATTRIBUTES ]=
stats._rows: a row naming an attribute in braces, {Brawn} {Agility} {Endurance} {Cognition} {Tech} {Presence}, shows that character's score. What each one covers, for reference, is documented on FAttributes in CharacterConfig.h and returned by FAttributes::Describe: Brawn is raw muscle power, heavy lifting and melee force; Agility is coordination, speed, dodging and fine motor skills; Endurance is immune system strength, stamina and resistance to toxins or radiation; Cognition is memory, logical deduction and academic knowledge; Tech is repair, hacking and operating futuristic machinery or starship systems; Presence is leadership, intimidation and social engineering.
stats._sections: The left column, top to bottom. Each block is a caption and its rows; a row may carry {Tokens}. Attribute tokens are {Brawn} {Agility} {Endurance} {Cognition} {Tech} {Presence}; derived tokens come from FAttributes::Derived in CharacterConfig.h -- {Vitality} {Kinetic} {Thermal} {Toxin} {Evasion} {Firewall}. Statuses and Talents are authored here for now: when a real status or talent system exists these rows become live and the placeholder lines go.

mirror._: camera relative to the head socket, cm; fov is horizontal on the 5:8 portrait target
mirror.caption: ==[ CHARACTER ]=
